svg.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash — dSpark
svg.desc: The V4.1 Flash reference supplies the draft path. DeepSpec publishes a complete single-sequence offline evaluator for Qwen3/Gemma4, including rejection sampling and cache cropping; it does not establish the V4.1 production coordinator. The linked V4-Pro-DSpark release is the V4-Pro checkpoint with an attached draft module, not V4.1 Flash. Its configuration and performance cannot be substituted here. V4.1 draft parameters remain unpublished and excluded from the backbone ledger.
